items.reason: Whether a committed value equal to the current one lands a step is the host's history: the description's forms and operations state what is written, and a history that records no unchanged edit, as the standalone and desktop hosts' do, keeps the undo stack free of steps that change nothing.

items.reason: A variable's width is the label's measured width (`notation node Variable size`, `autoSize: fitWidth`, never narrower than 90); how a label is measured, and whether the measured size travels to a client, is the host's text measurement.

hostCode.behaviour: The elementary cycles of the links, at most 1,000, found for each start variable in model order by a depth-first walk of the links in model order over the variables at or after it; a name written twice is one variable, the first, and the search says when it stopped at the bound.
A cycle's identity is its member names rotated to start at the ordinally least, so two statements of one loop that begin at different variables are the same loop.
The plugin `net.etalii.adp.systems.cldCycles` supplies `causalCycles(variables, links, max)` to the specification, each cycle a list of the first variable of each name it runs through.

A statement the binding leaves unread is told one of four sentences by what it starts like: an unknown first word, a link without its arrow, a link whose weight does not read as a number, and a variable with an empty id.
A weight reads as a number as .NET's invariant `double.TryParse` reads one: surrounding whitespace, a sign, digits with one decimal point, an exponent, and the names of the infinities and of NaN.
A statement's words are split at whitespace, a double-quoted run kept together without its quotes and an unclosed quote running to the end of the line.

A document opens with its variables evenly around a ring from the top and clockwise, on a radius that grows with the widest variable and the count so that no two neighbours overlap; a name written twice is placed once.

The ring seats variables by a depth-first walk of the links read as undirected from the first declared variable, earliest-declared neighbour first, continuing from the earliest variable left, and rounds each coordinate to a millionth.
A variable is as wide as its label's estimated width plus padding and never narrower than 90, 39.6 high, and the layouts keep 40 between boxes.

Arrange diagram is Meyer's self-organizing graphs made deterministic: a phyllotaxis start, Halton stimuli, ties to the earlier variable, 2,000 iterations, then at most 200 rounds of separation, declined past a budget of 1,000 elements.
A diagram past the budget, or whose boxes still overlap after the separation rounds, is not arranged, and the refusal names the size and the count of overlapping pairs.
In the dark theme a reinforcing loop's caption is #4daafc and a balancing loop's #fb923c, over the notation's dark mode.
The layouts and the cycle finder read the variables and links in model order, each named as the binding reads it without its quotes, a variable shown by its label or else its name.
Each variable is drawn where the registration stores it, as the centre of its box, and on the ring otherwise.
Arrange diagram on fewer than two variables answers with the specification's own reason.
Arrange diagram on a document that could not be read, without a registration, or whose registration was deleted, is refused with a sentence of the module's.
hostCode.reason: A document that is not open, could not be read, or has no registration to store positions in is the host's handling of the files it opens and registers: the description's operation states only what Arrange diagram needs of the model (two variables), and a host words why it has no document or no registration to write to.

hostCode.behaviour: Arrange diagram writes the self-organizing layout's centres as the registration's positions, in model order, as one undoable step.
Only a variable is placed by a drag; a link or a loop is refused with "Only a variable can be moved; a link is drawn between its ends and a loop label among its members.".
A new `layout:` block of the registration is written with CRLF line endings.
A statement the binding leaves unread is reported once on its line with the sentence the module words for it.
